abstract.en: A fire burning its own fuel supply.
abstract.cn: 一场烧掉自身燃料的火。

examples.en: The flood was highly destructive.
examples.cn: 这场洪水破坏性极强。

examples.en: Such remarks are destructive to a team.
examples.cn: 这类言论对团队有破坏性。

examples.en: They studied the destructive power of the quake.
examples.cn: 他们研究了这次地震的破坏力。

dict_mnemonic.text: destructive ＝ de（向下）＋ struct（建造，与 structure 同根拉丁语 struere）＋ -ive（倾向于…的）＝倾向于把建好的东西拆下去，「破坏性的」。

root: 拉丁语 struere（建造）→ de-＋struere → destruere（拆毁）→ destructivus → 英语 destructive

sensesIntro.en: One thing pulled down: a wall, a shared confidence and a person own habit.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一件被拆掉的东西：一面墙、一份共同的信心与一个人自己的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall pushed over with bricks scattered at your feet
core.cn: 核心意象：一面墙被推倒，砖块散在脚下

branches.en: A wall pushed over with bricks at your feet.
branches.cn: 一面被推倒的墙，砖块散在脚下。

branches.en: A crack widening in a shared wall.
branches.cn: 共用墙上一道不断变宽的裂缝。

branches.en: A fire burning its own fuel supply.
branches.cn: 一场烧掉自身燃料的火。

branches.en: Both leave something worse than before.
branches.cn: 两者都让事物比从前更糟。

branches.en: Both damage what cannot easily be rebuilt.
branches.cn: 两者都损坏难以重建的东西。

intro.en: Destructive is de- plus struct- plus -ive; the build root also raises construct and instruct.
intro.cn: destructive 由 de- 加 struct- 加 -ive 构成；建造这个词根也立起 construct 与 instruct。

latinIntro.en: Latin struere means to build, structura a fitting together and vastus empty or waste.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为建造，structura 意为拼接，vastus 意为空旷荒芜。

definition_zh: v. 分离；分开；拆卸；派遣；使（情感）抽离
definition_en: to remove something from what it is fastened to, to send a group away on a duty, or to keep feelings apart
core_image: 车厢之间的挂钩被解开，两节车分开；一个人从人群里退后一步，脸上没有表情
scene: 他把拖车从卡车上拆下来。He detached the trailer from the truck.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：detached 指拆开、分离；句意是他把拖车从卡车上拆下来。

collocations.phrase: detach the trailer from the truck
detach a coupon from the form

senses.title: Unfasten and separate
senses.definition: to remove something from the thing it is fastened to
senses.definitionCN: 把某物从它所连接的东西上取下
senses.example: He detached the trailer from the truck.
senses.exampleCN: 他把拖车从卡车上拆下来。
senses.why: A hook opened between two rail carriages.
senses.whyCN: 两节车厢之间被解开的挂钩。

senses.title: Send away on a task
senses.definition: to send a group away from the main body on a special duty
senses.definitionCN: 把一队人从主体中派出去执行特别任务
senses.example: The captain detached two boats to the island.
senses.exampleCN: 船长派两艘小艇去岛上。
senses.why: Two small boats leaving a larger ship.
senses.whyCN: 两艘小艇离开一艘大船。

senses.title: Keep feelings apart
senses.definition: to keep your feelings or opinions separate from a situation
senses.definitionCN: 把自己的感情或意见与情境分开
senses.example: She tried to detach herself from the argument.
senses.exampleCN: 她试着让自己从争吵中抽离。
senses.why: A person stepping back from a shouting crowd.
senses.whyCN: 一个人从叫嚷的人群里退后一步。

intro.en: Detach comes from French detacher, de- apart plus attacher to fasten, which goes back to Old French tache, a nail or tack.
intro.cn: detach 源自法语 détacher，由 dé-（分开）加 attacher（系住）构成，attacher 可追溯到古法语 tache（钉子、扣件）。

items.en: Tache meant a nail or fastening.
items.cn: 古法语 tache 意为钉子或扣件。

items.en: Attachier meant to fasten with a nail.
items.cn: attachier 意为用钉子固定。

items.en: Detacher meant to unfasten.
items.cn: 法语 détacher 意为解开、拆下。

items.en: Detach entered English for separating things.
items.cn: 十六世纪 detach 以分离义进入英语。

items.en: It gained the military sense of sending off.
items.cn: 十八世纪获得派遣军队的意思。

items.en: Detached now also describes a calm attitude.
items.cn: 如今 detached 也描述冷静超然的态度。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tach- fasten family; the near-meaning group names other ways of separating.
note.cn: 形近组共享 tach-（固定）家族；近义组是其他表示「分开」的词。

entries.definition: To fasten one thing to another; it shares the tache root but joins instead of separating.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物系到另一物上；共享 tache 词根，但是连接而非分开。

entries.definition: A thing fastened on, or a feeling of affection.
The act of separating, or a calm lack of involvement.
entries.definitionCN: 分离的行为，或冷静的不介入。

entries.definition: To move things apart so they are no longer together.
entries.definitionCN: 把事物分开，使不再在一起。

entries.definition: To undo a connection between two things.
To free something from what holds it.

normalIntro.en: Detach is de- apart plus tach- fasten: undo the fastening so the two parts come apart.
normalIntro.cn: detach 就是 de-（分开）加 tach-（固定）：解开固定，让两部分分开。

normal.en: Attach joins, detach unjoins.
normal.cn: attach 是接上，detach 是拆下。

normal.en: Tach- is a nail, as in tack.
normal.cn: tach- 是钉子，如 tack。

normal.en: Detach takes from.
normal.cn: detach 后面接 from。

normal.en: A detached house stands alone.
normal.cn: detached house 是独立式住宅。

normal.en: Detachment can mean a calm distance.
normal.cn: detachment 可以指冷静的距离感。

abstract.en: A hook opened between two rail carriages.
abstract.cn: 两节车厢之间被解开的挂钩。

abstract.en: Two small boats leaving a larger ship.
abstract.cn: 两艘小艇离开一艘大船。

abstract.en: A person stepping back from a shouting crowd.
abstract.cn: 一个人从叫嚷的人群里退后一步。

examples.en: Detach the coupon along the dotted line.
examples.cn: 沿虚线撕下优惠券。

examples.en: The coach was detached at the next station.
examples.cn: 这节车厢在下一站被解挂。

examples.en: He detached himself from the debate.
examples.cn: 他让自己从辩论中抽离。

dict_mnemonic.text: detach ＝ de（分开，对应 attach 的 a-）＋ tach（钉子、扣件，与 attach、tack 同源）＝把扣件解开，「分离、拆下」。

root: 古法语 tache（钉子、扣件）→ attachier（钉住）→ 法语 dé-＋attacher → détacher → 英语 detach

sensesIntro.en: One fastening undone: a hook, a ship boat and a step back from a crowd.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一处被解开的连接：一个挂钩、一艘离舰小艇与从人群退后的一步。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hook opened between two rail carriages so they roll apart
core.cn: 核心意象：两节车厢之间的挂钩被解开，各自滑开

branches.en: A hook opened between two rail carriages.
branches.cn: 两节车厢之间被解开的挂钩。

branches.en: Two small boats leaving a larger ship.
branches.cn: 两艘小艇离开一艘大船。

branches.en: A person stepping back from a shouting crowd.
branches.cn: 一个人从叫嚷的人群里退后一步。

branches.en: Both send a part away from the whole.
branches.cn: 两者都让一部分离开整体。

branches.en: Both create distance on purpose.
branches.cn: 两者都有意制造距离。

intro.en: Detach is de- plus tach-; the fasten root also builds attach and attachment.
intro.cn: detach 由 de- 加 tach- 构成；固定这个词根也造出 attach 与 attachment。

latinIntro.en: Latin dis- means apart, nectere to bind and separare to set apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dis- 意为分开，nectere 意为捆绑，separare 意为使分开。

definition_zh: 细节；详情；详细说明
definition_en: a small fact or feature that is part of a whole
core_image: 一张放大的照片，角落里藏着几样原来看不见的小东西
scene: 修表师傅把放大镜扣在眼上，连齿轮上的一道细痕都要看清。Every detail of the old watch had to be checked.
sceneCN: 这里 detail 指「细节」（第 1 个义项：构成整体的细小部分）；句意是这块旧表的每个细节都得检查。

senses.title: One small piece of a whole
senses.definition: a single small fact or feature that forms part of something larger
senses.definitionCN: 构成较大整体的一处细小事实或特征
senses.example: Every detail of the old watch had to be checked.
senses.exampleCN: 这块旧表的每个细节都得检查。
senses.why: The whole is not remembered by the eye; the small things are.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛记住的不是整体，而是那些小东西。

senses.title: The full facts
senses.definition: all the particular facts about an event or arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 关于某事件或安排的各项具体事实
senses.example: She explained the details of the contract to us.
senses.exampleCN: 她向我们解释了合同的详情。
senses.why: Small pieces gathered together become the information you need.
senses.whyCN: 小块拼在一起，就成了你真正需要的信息。

senses.title: Set it out point by point
senses.definition: to give all the particular facts about something in writing or speech
senses.definitionCN: 用书面或口头方式把某事的各项事实逐条给出
senses.example: The letter details every step of the journey.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信详述了旅程的每一步。
senses.why: The noun's small pieces become a verb when someone hands them out one by one.
senses.whyCN: 当人把小块一件件递出去，名词就变成了动词。

intro.en: Detail comes from French detail, built on de- and tailler, to cut, so a detail is a small piece cut off from a larger whole.
intro.cn: detail 来自法语 detail，由 de- 与 tailler（切割）构成，所以细节就是从整体上切下来的一小块。

items.en: Tailler meant to cut, and detail named a small cut-off piece.
items.cn: tailler 指切割，detail 指切下来的一小块。

items.en: Painters used it for the small parts of a picture.
items.cn: 画家用它来指一幅画里的小部分。

items.en: English borrowed it for small parts of accounts and designs.
items.cn: 英语借它来指账目与设计中的细小部分。

items.en: Military writers used the verb for listing duties one by one.
items.cn: 军事作者用它的动词形式逐条列出任务。

items.en: In detail is now the standard phrase for a close look.
items.cn: in detail 如今成了表示仔细查看的固定说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tail or detail shape, and the meaning group all name one piece of a larger thing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tail 或 detail 的形状，近义组则都指较大事物中的某一块。

entries.definition: giving many small facts
selling goods to ordinary buyers
a person who makes clothes to fit
one noticeable part of something
a single fact or item
entries.definitionCN: 单独的一条事实或项目

entries.definition: one part of a whole

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a magnifying glass over a watch and end with a letter that lists every step.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从扣在表上的放大镜开始，落到一封列出每一步的信。

normal.en: A detail is a small piece cut off so it can be studied alone.
normal.cn: 细节是被切下来、好单独研究的一小块。

normal.en: De- plus tailler is cutting: the whole is sliced thin.
normal.cn: de- 加 tailler 就是切：把整体切成薄片。

normal.en: The devil is in the detail because the small piece decides.
normal.cn: 关键藏在细节里，因为决定成败的正是那一小块。

normal.en: In detail means you have stopped stepping back.
normal.cn: in detail 就是不再往后退着看。

normal.en: A detailed plan is a plan that has been cut into small pieces.
normal.cn: 详细的计划，就是被切成许多小块的计划。

abstract.en: Picture a lens bringing one scratch into focus.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚镜片把一道划痕放到清晰处。

abstract.en: Picture a page of a contract with one clause circled.
abstract.cn: 想象合同的一页，其中一条被圈了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny screw lying beside a whole watch.
abstract.cn: 想象整只表旁边躺着一颗小螺丝。

examples.en: Every detail of the old watch had to be checked.
examples.cn: 这块旧表的每个细节都得检查。

examples.en: She explained the details of the contract to us.
examples.cn: 她向我们解释了合同的详情。

examples.en: The letter details every step of the journey.
examples.cn: 这封信详述了旅程的每一步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detail 记成「地忒细」：de 向下看，tail 像「细尾」，越往下看越细，就是细节。

root: 来自法语 detail，由 de- 与 tailler（切割）构成。本义是从整体上切下来的一小块，画家用它指画中的小部分，后来泛指一切构成整体的细小事实，又作动词表示逐条说明。

sensesIntro.en: From a small piece cut from the whole, to the set of all such pieces, to the act of handing them out one by one.
sensesIntro.cn: 从整体上切下的一小块，到所有小块的总和，再到把它们一件件递出去的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small piece cut from a larger surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：从较大表面上切下来的一小块。

branches.en: The first sense is one piece examined under the lens.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是镜片下被察看的那一小块。

branches.en: The second sense is the pile of such pieces gathered up.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是这样的小块被聚成的一堆。

branches.en: The third sense is the act of setting them out in order.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把它们按顺序摆出来的动作。

branches.en: One piece and the full set differ only in number.
branches.cn: 一小块与完整的一套，差别只在数量。

branches.en: Facts gathered can be handed on to someone else.
branches.cn: 收集起来的事实，可以再交给别人。

intro.en: Detail grows words for the cutting of small pieces, including the shop that sells in small pieces.
intro.cn: detail 长出与切小片有关的一族词，也包括把货物零散卖出的店铺。

latinIntro.en: The base is French tailler, to cut, from Latin talea, a cutting or a stick.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是法语 tailler（切割），源于拉丁语 talea（切下的枝条）。

items.meaning: a small part of a whole
the small facts of a matter
items.example: The details are on the form.

items.exampleCN: 她写了一份详细的报告。

items.meaning: the work of adding small parts
items.example: The detailing on the door is fine.
items.exampleCN: 这扇门的细部做得精细。
一名细部处理员检查了这辆车。

items.meaning: a person or shop that sells retail
one who cuts cloth to fit

definition_zh: v. 拘留；扣留；耽搁；留住（使不能离开）
definition_en: to keep someone in a place by official power, or to make them late by keeping them from leaving
core_image: 派出所的钟指向深夜，一个人坐在长椅上不能走；门口有人被礼貌地拦下寒暄
scene: 警方拘留了两名嫌疑人。Police detained two suspects.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：detained 指拘留；句意是警方拘留了两名嫌疑人。

senses.title: Hold by authority
senses.definition: to keep someone in a place by official power, especially the police
senses.definitionCN: 凭官方权力（尤指警方）把某人留在某处
senses.example: Police detained two suspects.
senses.exampleCN: 警方拘留了两名嫌疑人。
senses.why: A bench in a police room under a late clock.
senses.whyCN: 派出所里一座长椅，上方时钟已晚。

senses.title: Delay on the way
senses.definition: to make someone late by keeping them somewhere
senses.definitionCN: 把某人留在某处而使其迟到
senses.example: We were detained by the traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 我们被交通耽搁了。
senses.why: A car stopped at a closed level crossing.
senses.whyCN: 一辆车停在关闭的铁路道口前。

senses.title: Keep someone talking
senses.definition: to keep someone from leaving, often politely
senses.definitionCN: （常出于礼貌）不让某人离开
senses.example: She detained him at the door with questions.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口用问题留住了他。
senses.why: A guest in a doorway with a coat half on.
senses.whyCN: 门口一位外套只穿了一半的客人。

intro.en: Detain comes from Latin detinere, de- back plus tenere to hold, and reached English through Old French detenir.
intro.cn: detain 源自拉丁语 detinere，由 de-（扣住）加 tenere（握住）构成，经古法语 detenir 进入英语。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold.
items.cn: tenere 意为握住、持有。

items.en: Detinere meant to hold back.
items.cn: detinere 意为扣住不放。

items.en: Detenir carried the sense into French.
items.cn: 古法语 detenir 承接了这个意思。

items.en: Detain entered English for keeping someone back.
items.cn: 十五世纪 detain 以留住某人义进入英语。

items.en: It gained the legal sense of custody.
items.cn: 十七世纪获得法律上的拘留义。

items.en: Detainee now names the person held.
items.cn: 如今 detainee 指被拘留的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the ten- hold family; the near-meaning group names other ways of keeping someone back.
note.cn: 形近组共享 ten-（握住）家族；近义组是其他表示「扣住、留住」的词。

entries.definition: To keep something you already have; it shares tenere but keeps rather than holds back.
entries.definitionCN: 保留已有之物；共享 tenere，但是留住而非扣住。

entries.definition: To hold something inside; it shares tenere but concerns what is inside.
entries.definitionCN: 容纳；共享 tenere，但关乎内部装了什么。

entries.definition: The state of being kept in custody, or a school punishment.
entries.definitionCN: 被拘留的状态，或学校留堂处分。

entries.definition: To make something happen later than planned.
To keep someone or something in a position.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人或某物保持在某位置。

entries.definition: To keep someone within limits or in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 把某人限制在一定范围或某处。

normalIntro.en: Detain is de- back plus ten- hold: hold someone back so they cannot go on.
normalIntro.cn: detain 就是 de-（扣住）加 ten-（握住）：把人扣住，让他走不了。

normal.en: Ten- means hold, as in tenant.
normal.cn: ten- 意为握住，如 tenant。

normal.en: Detain is what police do to a suspect.
normal.cn: detain 是警方对嫌疑人做的事。

normal.en: Detention is the noun, detainee the person.
normal.cn: detention 是名词，detainee 是被扣的人。

normal.en: Detained by traffic means made late.
normal.cn: detained by traffic 就是被堵车耽搁。

normal.en: Retain keeps, detain holds back.
normal.cn: retain 是保留，detain 是扣住。

abstract.en: A bench in a police room under a late clock.
abstract.cn: 派出所里一座长椅，上方时钟已晚。

abstract.en: A car stopped at a closed level crossing.
abstract.cn: 一辆车停在关闭的铁路道口前。

abstract.en: A guest in a doorway with a coat half on.
abstract.cn: 门口一位外套只穿了一半的客人。

examples.en: He was detained for six hours.
examples.cn: 他被扣留了六个小时。

examples.en: The storm detained us at the airport.
examples.cn: 风暴把我们困在机场。

examples.en: Do not detain the witness any longer.
examples.cn: 不要再留住这位证人了。

dict_mnemonic.text: detain ＝ de（扣住、往下）＋ tain（握住，与 contain、retain 同根拉丁语 tenere）＝把人握住不放，「拘留、耽搁」。

root: 拉丁语 tenere（握住）→ de-＋tenere → detinere（扣住）→ 古法语 detenir → 英语 detain

sensesIntro.en: One person kept from going: a bench, a crossing and a doorway.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个走不了的人：一座长椅、一个道口与一处门口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bench in a police room under a clock that has gone past midnight
core.cn: 核心意象：派出所里一座长椅，上方时钟已过了午夜

branches.en: A bench in a police room under a late clock.
branches.cn: 派出所里一座长椅，上方时钟已晚。

branches.en: A car stopped at a closed level crossing.
branches.cn: 一辆车停在关闭的铁路道口前。

branches.en: A guest in a doorway with a coat half on.
branches.cn: 门口一位外套只穿了一半的客人。

branches.en: Both stop someone reaching where they meant to go.
branches.cn: 两者都让人到不了原本要去的地方。

branches.en: Both cost the person time.
branches.cn: 两者都耗掉了这个人的时间。

intro.en: Detain is de- plus ten-; the hold root also builds retain, contain and tenant.
intro.cn: detain 由 de- 加 ten- 构成；握住这个词根也造出 retain、contain 与 tenant。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere means to hold, mora a delay and finis a limit.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere 意为握住，mora 意为迟延，finis 意为界限。

definition_zh: 察觉；发现；检测
definition_en: to notice or find something that is not easy to see
core_image: 黑暗里一支手电扫过地面，照出一小片被踩乱的草
scene: 仪器在空气里筛了很久，终于亮起一盏小灯。The device can detect a gas leak within seconds.
sceneCN: 这里 detect 指「检测出」（第 2 个义项：用仪器或检验方法发现某物）；句意是这台装置能在几秒内检测出气体泄漏。

senses.title: Notice what is barely there
senses.definition: to notice something small or hidden that is not obvious
senses.definitionCN: 注意到不明显的小事或隐藏的事物
senses.example: He detected a slight change in her voice.
senses.exampleCN: 他察觉到她声音里有一点变化。
senses.why: The senses work below the level of attention and report a difference.
senses.whyCN: 感官在注意力之下工作，然后报告出一处不同。

senses.title: Find it with an instrument
senses.definition: to discover something by using a device or a test
senses.definitionCN: 借助装置或检验方法发现某物
senses.example: The device can detect a gas leak within seconds.
senses.exampleCN: 这台装置能在几秒内检测出气体泄漏。
senses.why: A machine can extend the senses into places a body cannot go.
senses.whyCN: 机器能把感官延伸到身体去不了的地方。

senses.title: Find it out after searching
senses.definition: to find out something hidden after careful looking or investigation
senses.definitionCN: 经过仔细查找或调查后发现隐藏的事
senses.example: Investigators detected a pattern in the thefts.
senses.exampleCN: 调查人员在这些盗窃案中查出了一个规律。
senses.why: Pieces that look separate become a pattern once someone compares them.
senses.whyCN: 看起来互不相干的碎片，一旦有人对照，就成了规律。

intro.en: Detect comes from Latin detegere, to uncover, built on de-, un-, and tegere, to cover.
intro.cn: detect 来自拉丁语 detegere（揭开），由 de-（去除）与 tegere（覆盖）构成。

items.en: Tegere meant to cover, as a roof covers a house.
items.cn: tegere 指覆盖，就像屋顶盖住房子。

items.en: Detegere meant to take the cover off and bring something to light.
items.cn: detegere 指把覆盖物拿走，让某物露出来。

items.en: Detectus described a thing laid bare.
items.cn: detectus 形容一件被摊开在光下的东西。

items.en: English used detect for uncovering a crime or a secret.
items.cn: 英语用 detect 表示揭出罪行或秘密。

items.en: Instruments gave the word its scientific sense of measuring faint signals.
items.cn: 仪器给了这个词测量微弱信号的科学含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tect shape, and the meaning group all describe becoming aware of something hidden.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tect 这一形状，近义组则都表示察觉到隐藏的事物。

entries.definition: a person who solves crimes
the act of finding something hidden
a device that finds something
to become aware of something
to find something for the first time
to see something suddenly

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a torch beam on trampled grass and end with a pattern inside a pile of reports.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黑暗中扫过草地的手电光开始，落到一叠报告里的规律。

normal.en: To detect is to take the cover off something that wanted to stay hidden.
normal.cn: 察觉就是把某样想藏起来的东西揭开盖。

normal.en: De- plus tegere: the roof comes off and the thing is seen.
normal.cn: de- 加 tegere：屋顶被掀开，东西就露出来了。

normal.en: A good ear detects what a loud room hides.
normal.cn: 好耳朵能听出吵闹房间藏起来的东西。

normal.en: A machine detects signals too faint for a hand to feel.
normal.cn: 机器能检测出手都感觉不到的微弱信号。

normal.en: Detectives detect patterns, not just single events.
normal.cn: 侦探查的是规律，不只是单个事件。

abstract.en: Picture a beam of light stopping on bent grass.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光停在压弯的草上。

abstract.en: Picture a small light turning red in a silent room.
abstract.cn: 想象安静房间里一盏小灯转红。

abstract.en: Picture three reports laid side by side with one number repeated.
abstract.cn: 想象三份报告并排摊开，同一个数字反复出现。

examples.en: He detected a slight change in her voice.
examples.cn: 他察觉到她声音里有一点变化。

examples.en: The device can detect a gas leak within seconds.
examples.cn: 这台装置能在几秒内检测出气体泄漏。

examples.en: Investigators detected a pattern in the thefts.
examples.cn: 调查人员在这些盗窃案中查出了一个规律。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detect 记成「地太克特」：de 是去掉，tect 是盖子，把盖子去掉，就察觉到了。

root: 来自拉丁语 detegere，由 de-（去除）与 tegere（覆盖）组成，本义是揭开覆盖物、使东西露出来。后来指发现隐藏的罪行与秘密，现代又指用仪器测出肉眼看不见的微弱信号。

sensesIntro.en: From a cover lifted off, to a faint signal caught by a machine, to a pattern found in scattered facts.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被揭开的盖子，到机器捕捉到的微弱信号，再到零散事实里找出的规律。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted so that something shows.
core.cn: 核心意象：盖子被掀开，某样东西露出来。

branches.en: The first sense is a small difference caught by the senses.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是感官捉住的一处细小不同。

branches.en: The second sense is a device doing the catching.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是由装置来完成这次捕捉。

branches.en: The third sense is a pattern assembled from many catches.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是用许多次捕捉拼出的规律。

branches.en: Ears and meters both work by noticing a difference.
branches.cn: 耳朵与仪表，都靠注意到一处不同来工作。

branches.en: One reading detects a leak; many readings detect a habit.
branches.cn: 一次读数检测出泄漏，许多次读数检测出一种习惯。

intro.en: Detect forms a family about uncovering, from the person who looks to the device that measures.
intro.cn: detect 长出一族表示揭开的词，从负责查找的人到负责测量的装置。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin tegere, to cover, and de- takes the cover away.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是拉丁语 tegere（覆盖），前缀 de- 把覆盖物拿走。

items.example: They detected smoke in the hall.
They spent the day detecting leaks.
items.exampleCN: 他们花了一天检测泄漏。

items.example: The error went undetected for years.
items.exampleCN: 这个错误多年未被发现。

definition_zh: 侦探；警探；侦探的
definition_en: a person, especially a police officer, whose job is to investigate crimes
core_image: 台灯下摊开的卷宗，旁边是一枚装进小纸袋的纽扣
scene: 雨夜的小办公室里，男人按灭烟头，翻开一叠照片。The detective studied the photographs until dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 detective 指「侦探」（第 1 个义项：专门查案的人）；句意是那名侦探研究照片直到天亮。

senses.title: A person who solves crimes
senses.definition: a person whose job is to find out who committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 以查明谁犯了罪为职业的人
senses.example: The detective questioned every neighbour on the street.
senses.exampleCN: 那名侦探询问了街上的每一位邻居。
senses.why: Someone has to stand between a quiet lie and the truth.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人站在安静的谎言与真相之间。

senses.title: A police investigator
senses.definition: a police officer who collects evidence and follows a case to its end
senses.definitionCN: 收集证据并把案件追到最后的警察
senses.example: A police detective arrived with a thin notebook.
senses.exampleCN: 一位警探带着薄薄的笔记本到了。
senses.why: The same curiosity now wears a badge and follows rules.
senses.whyCN: 同一种好奇心，如今戴上了警徽，也守着规矩。

senses.title: Relating to crime solving
senses.definition: used to describe stories, work or methods connected with solving crimes
senses.definitionCN: 用来形容与查案有关的故事、工作或方法
senses.example: She reads detective novels on the long train ride.
senses.exampleCN: 她在漫长的火车旅途中读侦探小说。
senses.why: The noun lent its name to the shelf it fills.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词把自己的名字借给了摆满它的书架。

intro.en: Detective was built inside English from detect plus -ive, and detect itself goes back to Latin detegere, to uncover.
intro.cn: detective 是在英语内部由 detect 加 -ive 造出来的，而 detect 又可追到拉丁语 detegere（揭开）。

items.en: Detegere joined de-, away, to tegere, to cover, and meant to uncover.
items.cn: detegere 把 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）拼在一起，意思是揭开。

items.en: Detect entered English as a verb meaning to expose what was hidden.
items.cn: detect 作为动词进入英语，指把隐藏的东西揭出来。

items.en: Britain coined detective for the new plain-clothes police.
items.cn: 英国为新出现的便衣警察造出了 detective 这个词。

items.en: Cheap magazines made the detective a hero of popular fiction.
items.cn: 廉价杂志让侦探成了通俗小说里的英雄。

items.en: The word now covers police officers and private investigators alike.
items.cn: 如今这个词既指警察，也指私人调查者。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the detect stem, and the meaning group names different kinds of people who follow clues.
note.cn: 形近组共用 detect 这个词干，近义组则给出几种循线索查案的人。

entries.definition: to notice or uncover something
the act of finding something hidden
a device that senses something
a person who examines facts carefully
a police officer of higher rank
a person who follows clues

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a lamp over an open file and end with a stranger asking quiet questions.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从照着摊开卷宗的台灯开始，落到轻声问话的陌生人。

normal.en: Detect plus -ive simply gives you the person who does the detecting.
normal.cn: detect 加上 -ive，就是做探查的那个人。

normal.en: A detective reads a room the way others read a page.
normal.cn: 侦探读一间屋子的方式，就像别人读一页纸。

normal.en: The coat is ordinary; only the questions are sharp.
normal.cn: 外套很普通，只有问题很锋利。

normal.en: Every clue is a sentence still waiting for its verb.
normal.cn: 每条线索都是一句还在等动词的话。

normal.en: Private or police, the job is the same: assemble the truth.
normal.cn: 私人也好，警察也好，活儿一样：把真相拼起来。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp with a green glass shade.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏罩着绿玻璃的台灯。

abstract.en: Picture a row of paper bags, each holding one small object.
abstract.cn: 想象一排纸袋，每只装着一件小东西。

abstract.en: Picture a hand drawing a line between two names.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在两个名字之间画一条线。

examples.en: The detective questioned every neighbour on the street.
examples.cn: 那名侦探询问了街上的每一位邻居。

examples.en: She hired a private detective to find her brother.
examples.cn: 她雇了一名私人侦探去找她的弟弟。

examples.en: Detective stories sell well at the station bookshop.
examples.cn: 侦探小说在车站书店卖得很好。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detective 记成「地泰克提夫」：de 是去掉，tect 是盖子，-ive 指人，专门把盖子掀开的人就是侦探。

root: 由英语动词 detect 加后缀 -ive 构成，而 detect 来自拉丁语 detegere（揭开覆盖物）。十九世纪英国为便衣警察造出这个词，后来既指警探，也指私人侦探，并引申出「侦探的」这一形容词用法。

sensesIntro.en: From a person who uncovers, to a police officer on a case, to the stories told about both.
sensesIntro.cn: 从揭开真相的人，到办案的警察，再到关于他们的故事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp, a file and one small object sealed in a paper bag.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏台灯、一份卷宗，以及纸袋里封着的一件小东西。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who does the assembling.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是做这次拼合的人。

branches.en: The second sense gives that person a badge.
branches.cn: 第二个义项给这个人一枚警徽。

branches.en: The third sense is the shelf of stories about such work.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是关于这类工作的那一架故事书。

branches.en: A private eye and a police officer share one method.
branches.cn: 私人侦探与警察共用一套方法。

branches.en: The worker and the fiction about the worker grew up together.
branches.cn: 真实的人与写他的小说是一起长大的。

intro.en: Detective belongs to a small family built on the act of uncovering.
intro.cn: detective 属于一小族词，都建在「揭开」这个动作上。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Latin tegere, to cover, and de- turns covering into uncovering.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是拉丁语 tegere（覆盖），前缀 de- 把覆盖变成揭开。

items.example: The detective waited outside the door.

items.exampleCN: 仪器能察觉微弱的信号。

items.example: Detection came too late to help.
items.exampleCN: 发现来得太晚，已经无济于事。
这种变化几乎察觉不到。
他悄无声息地溜了进去。
两名侦探共同负责这个案子。

definition_zh: v. 阻止；制止；威慑；使不敢（做某事）
definition_en: to stop someone doing something by making them fear the consequences, or to prevent an attack by threat of reply
core_image: 门口一块「内有恶犬」的牌子，来人停下脚步；罚款单贴在车窗上，下一次没人再乱停
scene: 高罚款能阻止乱扔垃圾。Heavy fines deter littering.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：deter 指阻止、使不敢；句意是高罚款能阻止乱扔垃圾。

senses.title: Stop by fear of cost
senses.definition: to stop someone doing something by making them fear the consequences
senses.definitionCN: 通过让人害怕后果来阻止其做某事
senses.example: Heavy fines deter littering.
senses.exampleCN: 高罚款能阻止乱扔垃圾。
senses.why: A fine notice fixed to a car window.
senses.whyCN: 一张贴在车窗上的罚款单。

senses.title: Discourage from trying
senses.definition: to make someone decide not to attempt something
senses.definitionCN: 使某人决定不去尝试某事
senses.example: The price deterred buyers from bidding.
senses.exampleCN: 这个价格让买家打消了出价的念头。
senses.why: A hand lifted then lowered at an auction.
senses.whyCN: 拍卖会上举起又放下的一只手。

senses.title: Guard by threat of force
senses.definition: to prevent an attack by showing that you can reply in kind
senses.definitionCN: 通过表明能同等回击来防止袭击
senses.example: The alliance exists to deter aggression.
senses.exampleCN: 这个联盟的存在是为了威慑侵略。
senses.why: A fence with a warning sign at a gate.
senses.whyCN: 大门上一道带警示牌的围栏。

intro.en: Deter comes from Latin deterrere, de- away plus terrere to frighten, the same root that gives terror and terrible.
intro.cn: deter 源自拉丁语 deterrere，由 de-（离开）加 terrere（使害怕）构成，与 terror、terrible 同根。

items.en: Terrere meant to frighten.
items.cn: terrere 意为使害怕。

items.en: Terror named great fear.
items.cn: terror 指极大的恐惧。

items.en: Deterrere meant to frighten away.
items.cn: deterrere 意为吓退。

items.en: Deter entered English for frightening someone off.
items.cn: 十六世纪 deter 以吓退义进入英语。

items.en: Deterrence became a nuclear strategy term.
items.cn: 二十世纪 deterrence 成为核战略术语。

items.en: Deterrent now names both a thing and a quality.
items.cn: 如今 deterrent 既指威慑物也指遏制的性质。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the terr- frighten family; the near-meaning group names other ways of stopping someone.
note.cn: 形近组共享 terr-（使害怕）家族；近义组是其他表示「阻止」的词。

entries.definition: Very great fear; it shares terrere but names the feeling, not the stopping.
entries.definitionCN: 极大的恐惧；共享 terrere，但指感受而非阻止。

entries.definition: Very bad or frightening; it shares terrere as an adjective of fear.
entries.definitionCN: 极糟的或可怕的；共享 terrere，是表恐惧的形容词。

entries.definition: Something that discourages an action by fear of its cost.
entries.definitionCN: 通过让人害怕代价而阻止行动的东西。

entries.definition: To make someone less willing to do something.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人不太愿意做某事。

entries.definition: To stop something from happening.
To persuade someone not to do something.

normalIntro.en: Deter is de- away plus terr- frighten: frighten someone away from an action.
normalIntro.cn: deter 就是 de-（离开）加 terr-（使害怕）：把人吓得离开某个行动。

normal.en: Terr- means frighten, as in terror.
normal.cn: terr- 意为使害怕，如 terror。

normal.en: Deter doubles the r before -ed.
normal.cn: deter 加 -ed 前要双写 r。

normal.en: Deter takes from plus -ing.
normal.cn: deter 后接 from 加 -ing。

normal.en: A deterrent is the thing that deters.
normal.cn: deterrent 就是起威慑作用的东西。

normal.en: Deterrence is the policy of deterring.
normal.cn: deterrence 是威慑政策。

abstract.en: A fine notice fixed to a car window.
abstract.cn: 一张贴在车窗上的罚款单。

abstract.en: A hand lifted then lowered at an auction.
abstract.cn: 拍卖会上举起又放下的一只手。

abstract.en: A fence with a warning sign at a gate.
abstract.cn: 大门上一道带警示牌的围栏。

examples.en: Nothing deterred her from applying.
examples.cn: 什么也没能阻止她申请。

examples.en: Cameras deter shoplifters.
examples.cn: 摄像头能震慑商店扒手。

examples.en: The risk of failure deters many starters.
examples.cn: 失败的风险让许多起步者却步。

dict_mnemonic.text: deter ＝ de（离开）＋ terr（使害怕，与 terror、terrible 同根拉丁语 terrere）＝把人吓离某件事，「阻止、威慑」。

root: 拉丁语 terrere（使害怕）→ de-＋terrere → deterrere（吓退）→ 英语 deter

sensesIntro.en: One action stopped before it starts: a fine, a lowered hand and a warned gate.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个在开始前就被停住的动作：一张罚款单、一只放下的手与一道带警示的大门。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine notice fixed to a car window so the next driver parks elsewhere
core.cn: 核心意象：一张罚款单贴在车窗上，让下一个司机把车停到别处

branches.en: A fine notice fixed to a car window.
branches.cn: 一张贴在车窗上的罚款单。

branches.en: A hand lifted then lowered at an auction.
branches.cn: 拍卖会上举起又放下的一只手。

branches.en: A fence with a warning sign at a gate.
branches.cn: 大门上一道带警示牌的围栏。

branches.en: Both make the cost feel too high.
branches.cn: 两者都让代价显得太高。

branches.en: Both stop an action before it begins.
branches.cn: 两者都在行动开始前把它止住。

intro.en: Deter is de- plus terr-; the frighten root also builds terror, terrible and terrify.
intro.cn: deter 由 de- 加 terr- 构成；使害怕这个词根也造出 terror、terrible 与 terrify。

latinIntro.en: Latin terrere means to frighten, terror great fear and cor the heart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 terrere 意为使害怕，terror 意为极大的恐惧，cor 意为心。

definition_zh: n. 清洁剂；洗涤剂 adj. 去污的；洗涤的
definition_en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or dishes, or having the power to lift dirt from a surface
core_image: 一滴洗洁精落进油碗，油膜向四周散开；洗衣机滚筒里泡沫翻起，衣物变干净
scene: 这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。This detergent removes grease.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：detergent 指洗涤剂；句意是这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。

senses.title: A washing substance
senses.definition: a substance used with water to clean clothes or dishes
senses.definitionCN: 与水一起用来清洗衣物或餐具的物质
senses.example: This detergent removes grease.
senses.exampleCN: 这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。
senses.why: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
senses.whyCN: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

senses.title: A cleaning power
senses.definition: the ability of a liquid to lift dirt from a surface
senses.definitionCN: 液体把污垢从表面带走的能力
senses.example: The detergent action lifts the stain.
senses.exampleCN: 这种去污作用把污渍带了起来。
senses.why: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
senses.whyCN: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

senses.title: A class of products
senses.definition: a type of cleaning product sold for a particular use
senses.definitionCN: 为某种用途出售的一类清洁产品
senses.example: They compared three laundry detergents.
senses.exampleCN: 他们比较了三种洗衣洗涤剂。
senses.why: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
senses.whyCN: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

intro.en: Detergent comes from Latin detergere, de- away plus tergere to wipe or cleanse; it is not related to deter, which comes from terrere, to frighten.
intro.cn: detergent 源自拉丁语 detergere，由 de-（去掉）加 tergere（擦拭、洗净）构成；它与 deter 无关，deter 来自 terrere（使害怕）。

items.en: Tergere meant to wipe or cleanse.
items.cn: tergere 意为擦拭、洗净。

items.en: Detergere meant to wipe away.
items.cn: detergere 意为擦掉、洗净。

items.en: Detergens was the present participle, wiping away.
items.cn: detergens 是现在分词，意为正在擦去的。

items.en: Detergent first described a cleansing medicine.
items.cn: 十七世纪 detergent 先指有清洁作用的药物。

items.en: It became the name for synthetic washing powders.
items.cn: 二十世纪它成为合成洗衣粉的名称。

items.en: Detergent now covers liquids and pods.
items.cn: 如今 detergent 涵盖洗衣液与凝珠。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the terg- wipe family and warns that deter is a different root; the near-meaning group names other cleaning substances.
note.cn: 形近组共享 terg-（擦拭）家族，并提醒 deter 是另一个词根；近义组是其他清洁用品。

entries.definition: To cleanse by wiping; it shares tergere and is the verb behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 擦拭洁净；共享 tergere，是这个名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: Using few words; it comes from tersus, wiped clean, so language with nothing extra.
entries.definitionCN: 用词简短的；来自 tersus（擦干净的），指没有多余成分的语言。

entries.definition: To frighten away; it looks similar but comes from terrere, not tergere.
entries.definitionCN: 吓退；形似但来自 terrere，而非 tergere。

entries.definition: A substance made from fat and alkali for washing.
entries.definitionCN: 由油脂与碱制成、用于洗涤的物质。

entries.definition: A substance used for cleaning skin or surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 用于清洁皮肤或表面的物质。

entries.definition: A liquid that dissolves another substance.
entries.definitionCN: 能溶解其他物质的液体。

normalIntro.en: Detergent is de- away plus terg- wipe: wipe the dirt away with water.
normalIntro.cn: detergent 就是 de-（去掉）加 terg-（擦拭）：用水把污垢擦走。

normal.en: Terg- means wipe, not frighten.
normal.cn: terg- 意为擦拭，不是使害怕。

normal.en: Deter and detergent are unrelated.
normal.cn: deter 与 detergent 并不同源。

normal.en: Terse shares the wiped clean root.
normal.cn: terse 共享「擦干净」这个词根。

normal.en: Laundry detergent washes clothes.
normal.cn: laundry detergent 洗衣服。

normal.en: Detergent can also be an adjective.
normal.cn: detergent 也可以作形容词。

abstract.en: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
abstract.cn: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

abstract.en: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
abstract.cn: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

abstract.en: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
abstract.cn: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

examples.en: Add a little detergent to the warm water.
examples.cn: 往温水里加一点洗涤剂。

examples.en: These detergents are safe for colours.
examples.cn: 这些洗涤剂对彩色衣物安全。

examples.en: Rinse off the detergent residue.
examples.cn: 把洗涤剂残留冲掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: detergent ＝ de（去掉）＋ terg（擦拭，拉丁语 tergere；terse「擦干净的→简洁的」同根）＋ -ent（…的物）＝把污垢擦掉的东西，「洗涤剂」。注意与 deter（terrere 使害怕）不同源。

root: 拉丁语 tergere（擦拭、洗净）→ de-＋tergere → detergere → 现在分词 detergens → 英语 detergent

sensesIntro.en: One bowl of oily water: a drop, a lifted stain and three bottles on a shelf.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一碗油水：一滴液体、一块被带起的污渍与货架上的三瓶清洁剂。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the grease film apart
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴落进油碗、把油膜向四周推开的液体

branches.en: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
branches.cn: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

branches.en: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
branches.cn: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

branches.en: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
branches.cn: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

branches.en: Both lift dirt off a surface.
branches.cn: 两者都把污垢从表面带走。

branches.en: Both name what does the cleaning.
branches.cn: 两者都指起清洁作用的东西。

intro.en: Detergent is de- plus terg- plus -ent; the wipe root also gives terse and abstergent.
intro.cn: detergent 由 de- 加 terg- 加 -ent 构成；擦拭这个词根也给出 terse 与 abstergent。

latinIntro.en: Latin tergere means to wipe, tersus wiped clean and solvere to loosen.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tergere 意为擦拭，tersus 意为擦干净的，solvere 意为松开。

definition_zh: 恶化；变坏；退化；变质；衰减
definition_en: to become progressively worse in quality, condition or state
core_image: 一面旧墙的抹灰从角上起皮，裂缝一天比一天宽，落下的粉末堆在墙脚
scene: 这栋楼长期没人维护，墙面起皮，管道也开始漏。Without maintenance the building will deteriorate within a few years.
sceneCN: 这里指建筑物状况逐渐变坏（第 3 个义项：环境或设施条件退化）；句意为若不维护，这栋楼几年内就会衰败。图中可辨识物件：起皮的墙面、裂缝、墙脚的粉末。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「恶化；退化；变质」
由该动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「不断恶化的」
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「已恶化的」
由该动词加表示倾向的形容词尾构成，义为「趋于恶化的」（少用）

senses.title: For health to worsen
senses.definition: for a person's physical or mental condition to decline steadily
senses.definitionCN: 人的身体或精神状况持续下滑
senses.example: His hearing deteriorated after years of noise exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 多年暴露在噪声中之后，他的听力变差了。
senses.why: The word describes a slide down a scale, and health is read on such a scale.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描述的是一路下滑，而健康状况正是按这样的刻度来读的。

senses.title: For relations to sour
senses.definition: for ties between people, groups or states to become less friendly over time
senses.definitionCN: 人与人、群体与群体或国与国之间的关系随时间变得不友好
senses.example: Relations between the two offices deteriorated after the dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 争执之后，两个办事处的关系变差了。
senses.why: A relationship is a standing structure, and deteriorate records its slow loss of strength.
senses.whyCN: 关系是一种立着的结构，这个词记录它缓慢失去强度。

senses.title: For conditions to degrade
senses.definition: for the physical state of a place, building or system to get progressively worse
senses.definitionCN: 场所、建筑或系统的物理状态逐步变差
senses.example: The housing stock deteriorated faster than the city could repair it.
senses.exampleCN: 住房状况恶化的速度超过了城市的修缮能力。
senses.why: Materials and places wear down in one direction, and the verb names that one-way drift.
senses.whyCN: 材料与场所只朝一个方向磨损，这个词命名那种单向漂移。

senses.title: For quality to decline
senses.definition: for the quality of a product or material to fall below an earlier standard
senses.definitionCN: 产品或材料的质量降到早先标准之下
senses.example: The stored grain deteriorated because the silo was damp.
senses.exampleCN: 因为粮仓潮湿，储存的谷物变质了。
senses.why: Quality is a level, and the verb says the level keeps dropping.
senses.whyCN: 质量是一个水平线，这个词说这条线一直在往下掉。

senses.title: For performance to decay
senses.definition: for a machine or system to work less well than before
senses.definitionCN: 机器或系统的运转效果不如从前
senses.example: Battery performance deteriorates in freezing weather.
senses.exampleCN: 电池性能在严寒天气里会衰减。
senses.why: Engineering treats wear as a predictable curve, and deteriorate is the verb for the downward part.
senses.whyCN: 工程把磨损看作一条可预测的曲线，这个词专指向下的那一段。

senses.title: For economic indicators to weaken
senses.definition: for trade, output or confidence to move towards a worse position
senses.definitionCN: 贸易、产出或信心朝更差的方向移动
senses.example: The trade balance deteriorated for the third quarter running.
senses.exampleCN: 贸易差额连续第三个季度恶化。
senses.why: Economists read a falling line as a worsening, and the verb carries no other emotion.
senses.whyCN: 经济学家把下行的曲线读作恶化，这个词不带别的情绪。

senses.title: For a medical condition to progress badly
senses.definition: for a disease or a patient's state to move towards a worse stage
senses.definitionCN: 疾病或病人的状态走向更差的阶段
senses.example: The patient deteriorated overnight and was moved to intensive care.
senses.exampleCN: 病人一夜之间恶化，被转入重症监护。
senses.why: Clinical writing uses the verb for the direction of a course, not for its speed.
senses.whyCN: 临床记录用这个动词说明病程方向，而不说明速度。

senses.title: For order or safety to decline
senses.definition: for public order, security or discipline to become weaker or more dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 公共秩序、安全或纪律变得薄弱或更危险
senses.example: Security in the district deteriorated after the patrols stopped.
senses.exampleCN: 巡逻停止后，该区的治安恶化了。
senses.why: Order is a structure held by many hands, and the verb marks the strain that loosens it.
senses.whyCN: 秩序是许多只手撑着的结构，这个词标出把它松开的那些拉力。

intro.en: Deteriorate comes from Late Latin deteriorare, to make worse, from deterior, worse, a comparative whose positive form is not attested. French and English adopted the verb in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: 这个词来自晚期拉丁语 deteriorare「使变坏」，出自比较级 deterior「更坏」，而其原级形式并无记录；法语与英语在十六世纪采用它。

items.en: Deterior was the comparative of an older adjective meaning lower or inferior, and that positive form survives only as a reconstruction.
items.cn: 这是较古形容词「较低、较差」的比较级，而那个原级只以重构形式存在，没有实际记录。

items.en: The verb meant to make worse or to become worse, and it appears mainly in later technical and medical writing.
items.cn: 这个动词意为使变坏或变坏，主要见于较晚的技术与医学文献。

items.en: French formed its own verb from the same Latin comparative and passed it to English.
items.cn: 法语由同一拉丁比较级造出自己的动词，再传给英语。

items.en: English records the verb from the sixteenth century; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语自十六世纪有记录，确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The base adjective behind deterior cannot be recovered from any surviving text, so its source is uncertain.
items.cn: deterior 背后的原级形容词无法从任何传世文本中复原，因此标记为来源不确定。

items.en: Medicine and economics gave the verb fixed subjects such as condition, patient and balance.
items.cn: 医学与经济学给这个动词添了固定主语，如状况、病人与收支。

note.en: The first group looks close or shares the deteriorating stem; the second group names neighbouring ideas of decline.
note.cn: 第一组与「deteriorate」形近或共享「恶化」词干；第二组是与「下滑」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The noun for the process of becoming worse.
entries.definitionCN: 指变坏这一过程的名词。

entries.definition: The adjective for something in the middle of getting worse.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指正处在恶化过程中的。

entries.definition: To settle or decide, from terminus, a boundary; it looks close but is unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 指确定、决定，出自「边界」；形近但无亲缘。

entries.definition: Something that discourages an action, from a verb meaning to frighten away.
entries.definitionCN: 指起威慑作用的事物，出自「吓退」的动词。

entries.definition: Harm or damage, from a different Latin stem.
entries.definitionCN: 指损害，出自另一拉丁词干。

entries.definition: To become or make worse, the plainest verb of the group.
entries.definitionCN: 指变坏或使变坏，是本组最朴素的说法。

entries.definition: To go down in amount or quality, often neutral in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 指数量或质量下降，语气常较中性。

entries.definition: To lower in quality, rank or condition.
entries.definitionCN: 指质量、等级或状况降低。

entries.definition: To rot or break down slowly through natural processes.
entries.definitionCN: 指经自然过程缓慢腐烂或分解。

entries.definition: To wear away gradually, literally by wind or water.
entries.definitionCN: 指逐渐磨损，字面多指风水侵蚀。

entries.definition: To fall suddenly in value or performance.
entries.definitionCN: 指价值或表现突然下跌。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the worse comparative, its missing base, and the fixed subjects medicine and economics give it.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用「更坏」这一比较级、它缺失的原级，以及医学与经济学给它的固定主语。

normal.en: Deterior is already a comparative, so the word starts from the idea of worse, not bad.
normal.cn: deterior 本身是比较级，所以这个词从「更坏」而不是「坏」起步。

normal.en: The positive adjective behind it never survived, which is the honest reason for marking its origin uncertain.
normal.cn: 它背后的原级形容词没有传下来，这正是把来源标为存疑的诚实理由。

normal.en: Doctors write that a patient deteriorated overnight.
normal.cn: 医生会写病人一夜之间恶化。

normal.en: Economists write that the trade balance deteriorated.
normal.cn: 经济学家会写贸易差额恶化。

normal.en: Deterioration is the noun, and deteriorating is the adjective used before situation.
normal.cn: 名词是 deterioration，形容词 deteriorating 常用于 situation 之前。

abstract.en: To deteriorate is to lose strength without any single blow, which is the hardest kind of damage to notice.
abstract.cn: 恶化是没有一次重击却不断失去强度，这是最难察觉的一种损坏。

abstract.en: Every system has a downward curve, and the word simply names the slope.
abstract.cn: 每个系统都有一条下行曲线，这个词只是给那道坡命名。

abstract.en: Things do not usually collapse; they first become slightly worse than yesterday.
abstract.cn: 事物通常不是突然崩塌的，而是先比昨天差一点。

examples.en: The road surface deteriorated quickly after the winter frosts.
examples.cn: 冬季霜冻之后，路面很快恶化了。

examples.en: Their working relationship deteriorated after the failed merger.
examples.cn: 合并失败后，他们的工作关系变差了。

examples.en: Air quality deteriorates whenever the wind drops.
examples.cn: 风一停，空气质量就恶化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「迪提里奥瑞特」——旧墙起皮，裂缝一天比一天宽：恶化、变坏

root: 拉丁语 deterior「更坏」（比较级，原级无传世记录，直接来源不确定）→ 晚期拉丁语 deteriorare「使变坏」→ 法语 détériorer；英语十六世纪引入。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one downward slope through health, relations, places, quality, machinery, economy, illness and public order.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一条下坡走过健康、关系、场所、质量、机器、经济、病情与治安。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: plaster flakes off an old wall and the crack widens a little every day.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧墙抹灰一片片起皮，裂缝每天宽一点。

branches.en: THE BODY SLIDES: a person's condition or a disease course moves to a worse stage.
branches.cn: 身体下滑：人的状况或病程走向更差的阶段。

branches.en: THE TIE LOOSENS: relations lose their friendliness without any single break.
branches.cn: 纽带松了：关系失去友好，却不是一次断裂。

branches.en: THE MATERIAL WEARS: buildings and stored goods fall below an earlier standard.
branches.cn: 材料磨损：建筑与存粮降到早先标准之下。

branches.en: THE MACHINE LOSES EDGE: output falls as parts age or conditions harden.
branches.cn: 机器失锋：部件老化或条件变严，输出随之下降。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM SAGS: balances weaken and public order grows more dangerous.
branches.cn: 系统下沉：收支走弱，治安变得更危险。

intro.en: Deteriorate is a Late Latin verb built on a comparative adjective, so its affixes are the endings of comparison and of verb formation.
intro.cn: 这是一个建立在比较级形容词上的晚期拉丁动词，其词缀是比较级与动词构成用的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies deterior and deteriorare; the positive adjective behind deterior is not attested, so the base is marked uncertain rather than invented.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了 deterior 与 deteriorare；deterior 背后的原级形容词没有记录，因此只标存疑，不作编造。

items.example: The comparative already carries the direction of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个比较级已经带上了这个词的方向。

items.example: It marks the form as a comparison, not a positive quality.
items.exampleCN: 它标明该形式是比较级，而非原级性质。

items.example: The verb turns the comparison into a process.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词把比较变成过程。

items.example: It forms the adjective for what has already worsened.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「已恶化」的形容词。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「恶化；退化」
由该动词加形容词后缀构成，义为「不断恶化的」
由该动词加表示倾向的形容词尾构成，义为「趋于恶化的」（少用）
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「已恶化的」

definition_zh: n. 恶化；变坏；退化；（材料的）劣化
definition_en: the process of becoming progressively worse in condition, quality or value
core_image: 墙上的裂缝一年比一年宽；体检报告上的箭头连续三次朝上
scene: 病情出现了恶化。There was a deterioration in his condition.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：deterioration 指恶化；句意是病情出现了恶化。

senses.title: A process of getting worse
senses.definition: the process of becoming progressively worse
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐变得更糟的过程
senses.example: There was a deterioration in his condition.
senses.exampleCN: 病情出现了恶化。
senses.why: A wall crack wider than it was last year.
senses.whyCN: 一道比去年更宽的墙缝。

senses.title: A fall in quality or value
senses.definition: a decline in the quality, value or strength of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物的质量、价值或强度下降
senses.example: The report noted a deterioration in service.
senses.exampleCN: 报告指出服务质量下降。
senses.why: An arrow pointing down on a results chart.
senses.whyCN: 成绩图表上一个向下的箭头。

senses.title: Damage to a material
senses.definition: the physical breaking down of a material over time
senses.definitionCN: 材料随时间发生的物理性损坏
senses.example: Deterioration of the pipes caused the leak.
senses.exampleCN: 管道劣化导致了漏水。
senses.why: A rusty pipe flaking at a joint.
senses.whyCN: 接口处正在剥落锈片的管道。

intro.en: Deterioration comes from Latin deteriorare, to make worse, from deterior, worse, built with de- down and the comparative ending -ter.
intro.cn: deterioration 源自拉丁语 deteriorare（使变坏），来自 deterior（更坏的），由 de-（向下）加比较级后缀 -ter 构成。

items.en: De meant down or away.
items.cn: de 意为向下、离开。

items.en: Deterior meant worse, lower than before.
items.cn: deterior 意为更坏的、比从前低的。

items.en: Deteriorare meant to make worse.
items.cn: deteriorare 意为使变坏。

items.en: Deteriorate entered English first as a verb.
items.cn: 十六世纪 deteriorate 先以动词进入英语。

items.en: Deterioration followed as the noun of the process.
items.cn: 十八世纪 deterioration 作为过程名词随之出现。

items.en: It is now standard in medical and technical reports.
items.cn: 如今它是医疗与技术报告中的标准用词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the deterior- worse family and the -terior ending; the near-meaning group names other words for getting worse.
note.cn: 形近组共享 deterior-（更坏）家族与 -terior 结尾；近义组是其他表示「变糟」的词。

entries.definition: To become worse; it is the verb behind this noun.
entries.definitionCN: 变坏；是这个名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: The inside of something; it shares the -terior ending but not the worse sense.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的内部；共享 -terior 结尾，但没有「更坏」的意思。

entries.definition: The outside of something; it shares -terior but concerns position, not quality.
entries.definitionCN: 某物的外部；共享 -terior，但关乎位置而非质量。

entries.definition: A gradual loss of quality, strength or value.
entries.definitionCN: 质量、力量或价值的逐渐下降。

entries.definition: The process of rotting or breaking down.
The process of becoming worse in quality or condition.
entries.definitionCN: 质量或状况变差的过程。

normalIntro.en: Deterioration is deterior- worse plus -ation process: the process of moving further down.
normalIntro.cn: deterioration 就是 deterior-（更坏）加 -ation（过程）：一步步往下走的过程。

normal.en: Deterior means worse in Latin.
normal.cn: deterior 在拉丁语里意为更坏。

normal.en: -ation turns the verb into a process noun.
normal.cn: -ation 把动词变成过程名词。

normal.en: Deterioration in health is a set phrase.
normal.cn: deterioration in health 是固定搭配。

normal.en: It is usually uncountable.
normal.cn: 它通常不可数。

normal.en: Interior shares the ending, not the meaning.
normal.cn: interior 共享结尾，但不共享意思。

abstract.en: A wall crack wider than it was last year.
abstract.cn: 一道比去年更宽的墙缝。

abstract.en: An arrow pointing down on a results chart.
abstract.cn: 成绩图表上一个向下的箭头。

abstract.en: A rusty pipe flaking at a joint.
abstract.cn: 接口处正在剥落锈片的管道。

examples.en: Doctors watched for any deterioration.
examples.cn: 医生留意任何恶化迹象。

examples.en: The deterioration of the bridge was slow.
examples.cn: 这座桥的劣化是缓慢的。

examples.en: We must prevent further deterioration.
examples.cn: 我们必须防止进一步恶化。

dict_mnemonic.text: deterioration ＝ deterior（更坏的，拉丁语 de「向下」＋比较级 -ter）＋ -ation（过程名词）＝一步步往下变坏的过程，「恶化」。

root: 拉丁语 de（向下）＋比较级后缀 -ter → deterior（更坏的）→ deteriorare（使变坏）→ deterioratio → 英语 deterioration

sensesIntro.en: One thing going down: a wall crack, a service chart and a rusty pipe.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一件往下走的东西：一道墙缝、一张服务图表与一根锈管。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall crack wider than it was last year, with the arrow on the report still pointing down
core.cn: 核心意象：一道比去年更宽的墙缝，报告上的箭头仍朝下

branches.en: A wall crack wider than it was last year.
branches.cn: 一道比去年更宽的墙缝。

branches.en: An arrow pointing down on a results chart.
branches.cn: 成绩图表上一个向下的箭头。

branches.en: A rusty pipe flaking at a joint.
branches.cn: 接口处正在剥落锈片的管道。

branches.en: Both show a steady move downward.
branches.cn: 两者都显示持续向下的走势。

branches.en: Both name a loss of usable quality.
branches.cn: 两者都指可用质量的丧失。

intro.en: Deterioration is deterior- plus -ation; the worse stem also builds deteriorate.
intro.cn: deterioration 由 deterior- 加 -ation 构成；更坏这个词干也造出 deteriorate。

latinIntro.en: Latin deterior means worse, interior inner and exterior outer.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 deterior 意为更坏的，interior 意为内部的，exterior 意为外部的。

definition_zh: 决心；决定；确定；测定
definition_en: the quality of continuing to try despite difficulty, or the act of deciding something firmly
core_image: 桌下握紧的拳头，脸上却仍旧平静地看着前方
scene: 长跑最后一圈，她的双腿在抖，眼神却没有散。Her determination carried her through the final mile.
sceneCN: 这里 determination 指「决心」（第 1 个义项：坚持到底的意志）；句意是她的决心带她跑完了最后一英里。

senses.title: Firmness of purpose
senses.definition: the quality of continuing to try even when something is difficult
senses.definitionCN: 即使困难也继续尝试的品质
senses.example: Her determination carried her through the final mile.
senses.exampleCN: 她的决心带她跑完了最后一英里。
senses.why: The legs were ready to stop; something above them refused.
senses.whyCN: 双腿已经准备停下，是更上面的什么东西不肯。

senses.title: A firm decision
senses.definition: a formal decision that settles a question for good
senses.definitionCN: 把某个问题彻底定下来的正式决定
senses.example: The committee reached a determination after two hours.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会两小时后作出了决定。
senses.why: A matter is weighed once, then the scale is allowed to rest.
senses.whyCN: 事情称过一次，然后就让秤停下来。

senses.title: Working something out exactly
senses.definition: the act of finding out an amount or a cause precisely
senses.definitionCN: 精确查明某个数量或原因的行为
senses.example: The determination of the cause took several weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 查明原因花了几个星期。
senses.why: To determine is to put a boundary around an unknown.
senses.whyCN: 所谓确定，就是给一片未知画上边界。

intro.en: Determination comes from Latin determinare, to set a limit, built from de- and terminus, a boundary stone, and it passed through French.
intro.cn: determination 来自拉丁语 determinare（划定界限），由 de- 与 terminus（界石）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Terminus meant a boundary stone, and determinare meant to set a limit.
items.cn: terminus 指界石，determinare 指划定界限。

items.en: The word also meant to settle a question by fixing its edges.
items.cn: 这个词也指把问题的边界钉死，从而把它了结。

items.en: French determination carried the sense of a settled decision.
items.cn: 法语 determination 带着「已经定下的决定」这层意思。

items.en: English used it for a legal ruling and for firmness of mind.
items.cn: 英语用它同时表示法律裁决与内心的坚定。

items.en: Science added the exact measurement of an amount or a cause.
items.cn: 科学又添上精确测定数量或原因这一用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the termin stem, while the meaning group covers resolve, persistence and decisions.
note.cn: 形近组共用 termin 这个词干，近义组则覆盖决意、坚持与决定。

entries.definition: to decide or find out something firmly
entries.definitionCN: 坚定地决定或查明某事

entries.definition: having a strong wish to do something
entries.definitionCN: 怀着强烈意愿去做某事的

entries.definition: the end of a line or a building for travellers
entries.definitionCN: 线路的终点或旅客集散的建筑

entries.definition: a firm decision to do something
the act of continuing despite difficulty
a choice that has been made

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a clenched fist under a desk and end with a boundary stone in a field.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌下攥紧的拳头开始，落到田野里的一块界石。

normal.en: Terminus is a boundary stone, so to determine is to mark where a thing ends.
normal.cn: terminus 是一块界石，所以 determine 就是标出某物到哪儿为止。

normal.en: Determination is a line you draw and then refuse to move.
normal.cn: 决心就是你画下一条线，然后拒绝挪动它。

normal.en: A firm decision is quiet; it has no need to shout.
normal.cn: 坚定的决定是安静的，它不必喊。

normal.en: The same word settles a debate and measures a cause.
normal.cn: 同一个词既了结争论，也测定原因。

normal.en: Where the stone stands, the argument stops.
normal.cn: 界石立在哪儿，争论就停在哪儿。

abstract.en: Picture a stone half sunk in wet grass.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头半埋在湿草里。

abstract.en: Picture a fist opening slowly on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只拳头在桌面上慢慢松开。

abstract.en: Picture a scale arm settling at last.
abstract.cn: 想象天平的长臂终于稳住。

examples.en: Her determination carried her through the final mile.
examples.cn: 她的决心带她跑完了最后一英里。

examples.en: He spoke with quiet determination about the plan.
examples.cn: 他平静而坚定地谈起这个计划。

examples.en: The result was never really in doubt.
examples.cn: 结果其实从来没有悬念。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 determination 记成「地特米内神」：de 是定下，termin 是边界，把边界钉死，就是确定，也是决心。

root: 来自拉丁语 determinare，由 de-（加强）与 terminus（界石、边界）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是划定边界、把问题定死，后来引申为作出决定，又引申为内心的坚定与精确测定。

sensesIntro.en: From a will that will not bend, to a question closed for good, to an amount measured exactly.
sensesIntro.cn: 从不肯弯折的意志，到被彻底了结的问题，再到被精确测出的数量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boundary stone driven into the ground and a hand that will not move it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块界石被钉进地里，而有一只手不肯挪动它。

branches.en: The first sense is the will that keeps standing at the stone.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是始终守在界石旁的那股意志。

branches.en: The second sense is the moment the boundary closes a debate.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是边界把争论关上的那一刻。

branches.en: The third sense is the measuring that finds where the edge really is.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是找出边界究竟在哪里的测量。

branches.en: A settled decision and a steady will are the same line seen twice.
branches.cn: 已定的决定与稳定的意志，是同一条线被看了两次。

branches.en: To decide and to measure both put an end to vagueness.
branches.cn: 作决定与作测量，都在终结含糊。

intro.en: Determination has a family built on the Latin boundary stone and on the act of fixing a limit.
intro.cn: determination 有一族词，建在拉丁语的界石与「划界」这个动作上。

latinIntro.en: The base is terminus, a boundary, and de- plus -ation turn it into the act of setting limits.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 terminus（边界），加上 de- 与 -ation，就成了划定界限这一行为。

items.exampleCN: 她的决心让所有人吃惊。

items.meaning: to decide or find out exactly
items.example: They will determine the cause soon.
items.exampleCN: 他们很快就会查明原因。

items.meaning: a factor that decides a result
items.exampleCN: 成本是主要的决定因素。

items.meaning: the belief that all events are fixed

items.example: The delay was of indeterminate length.
items.exampleCN: 这次延误的长短并不确定。

items.example: Determining the date took a week.

definition_zh: 决定；确定；查明；支配
definition_en: to decide something firmly, or to find out something exactly
core_image: 一支笔在地图上重重画下一道线，把范围钉住
scene: 会议开到深夜，几个人围着地图争论，最后有人把笔往桌上一放。They determined the route before sunrise.
sceneCN: 这里 determine 指「决定」（第 1 个义项：把事情定下来）；句意是他们在日出前定下了路线。

senses.title: Decide firmly
senses.definition: to decide something after thinking about the choices
senses.definitionCN: 在权衡各种选择之后把某件事定下来
senses.example: They determined the route before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在日出前定下了路线。
senses.why: A choice becomes real only when it is written down.
senses.whyCN: 选择只有被写下来，才算真正落地。

senses.title: Find out exactly
senses.definition: to discover a fact or an amount by careful study
senses.definitionCN: 通过仔细研究弄清一个事实或数量
senses.example: Tests will determine the cause of the fault.
senses.exampleCN: 测试将查明故障的原因。
senses.why: The answer is already there; you only fix its outline.
senses.whyCN: 答案本来就在那里，你只是把它的轮廓钉住。

senses.title: Control the result
senses.definition: to be the fact that decides what something will be like
senses.definitionCN: 成为决定某事物会是什么样子的那个因素
senses.example: Location often determines the price of a house.
senses.exampleCN: 地段常常决定一套房子的价格。
senses.why: One strong fact can set the boundary for all the rest.
senses.whyCN: 一个强有力的事实，能为其余一切划出边界。

intro.en: Determine comes from Latin determinare, to set a boundary, formed from de- and terminus, a boundary stone, and it came through French.
intro.cn: determine 来自拉丁语 determinare（划定边界），由 de- 与 terminus（界石）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Terminus was the stone that marked where a field ended.
items.cn: terminus 就是标出田地到哪儿为止的那块石头。

items.en: Determinare meant to fix that limit and so to settle a matter.
items.cn: determinare 指把这条界限钉住，从而把事情了结。

items.en: French determiner kept both the legal and the everyday sense.
items.cn: 法语 determiner 同时保留了法律与日常两层用法。

items.en: English used it for deciding a question and for fixing a date.
items.cn: 英语用它表示裁决问题，也表示确定日期。

items.en: Science made it the standard verb for finding a value.
items.cn: 科学让它成为表示求出一个数值的常用动词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the termin shape, and the meaning group moves from deciding to proving and controlling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 termin 的形状，近义组则从作出决定走到证实与支配。

entries.definition: firmness of purpose or a settled decision
entries.definitionCN: 意志的坚定或已定的决定

entries.definition: having a strong wish to do something
entries.definitionCN: 怀着强烈意愿去做某事的

entries.definition: coming at the end of something
to choose after thinking
to find out a fact for certain
to end a doubt or an argument

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a pen pressed onto a map and end with a price tag that explains everything.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一支笔压在地图上开始，落到一张解释一切的价签。

normal.en: To determine is to put a terminus, a boundary, around a question.
normal.cn: determine 就是给一个问题围上 terminus，也就是边界。

normal.en: A date is determined; a cause is determined; both stop the guessing.
normal.cn: 日期要定，原因要查，两件事都在终止猜测。

normal.en: What determines a house price often sits outside the house.
normal.cn: 决定房价的东西，常常在房子外面。

normal.en: Write the line down and the choice stops being a mood.
normal.cn: 把那条线写下来，选择就不再只是一种心情。

normal.en: The map is large, but one firm stroke makes it small.
normal.cn: 地图很大，但坚定的一笔就让它变小。

abstract.en: Picture a pen pressing a dark line across paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一支笔在纸上压出一道深线。

abstract.en: Picture a row of choices narrowing to one door.
abstract.cn: 想象一排选择渐渐收窄成一扇门。

abstract.en: Picture a small stone that decides where two fields meet.
abstract.cn: 想象一块小石头决定两块田在哪儿相接。

examples.en: They determined the route before sunrise.
examples.cn: 他们在日出前定下了路线。

examples.en: Tests will determine the cause of the fault.
examples.cn: 测试将查明故障的原因。

examples.en: She was determined to finish the race.
examples.cn: 她下定决心要跑完这场比赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 determine 记成「地特敏」：de 是定下，termin 是边界，把边界一钉，事情就定下来、也查清楚了。

root: 来自拉丁语 determinare，由 de-（加强）与 terminus（界石、边界）组成，经古法语 determiner 进入英语。本义是划定界限，引申为把问题定下来、作出决定，再引申为查明与支配。

sensesIntro.en: From drawing a line through a choice, to fixing the outline of a fact, to being the fact that rules the rest.
sensesIntro.cn: 从在众多选择中划下一道线，到钉住一个事实的轮廓，再到成为支配其余一切的那个事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pen pressing a firm line across a map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支笔在地图上压出一道坚定的线。

branches.en: The first sense is the stroke that turns thinking into a choice.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把思考变成选择的那一笔。

branches.en: The second sense is the same stroke drawn around a hidden fact.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是围着隐藏事实画下的同一笔。

branches.en: The third sense is a line so strong that other things must follow it.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一条强到别的都得顺着它走的线。

branches.en: Deciding and discovering both end with a boundary that holds.
branches.cn: 作决定与查真相，最后都落到一条立得住的边界上。

branches.en: What you find out often becomes what controls the outcome.
branches.cn: 你查明的东西，常常就成了支配结果的东西。

intro.en: Determine stands at the centre of a family about limits, decisions and exact findings.
intro.cn: determine 站在一族词的中心，这族词关于界限、决定与精确查明。

latinIntro.en: The base is terminus, a boundary stone, and de- gives the act of fixing it.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 terminus（界石），前缀 de- 给出「把它钉住」这个动作。

items.meaning: to decide or find out exactly
items.example: We must determine the facts first.

items.meaning: a word that limits a noun
items.example: The word this is a determiner.
The plant is of indeterminate height.
items.exampleCN: 这种植物的高度不确定。

items.meaning: the act of settling a matter
items.example: Determining the winner took an hour.

definition_zh: n. 绕道；便道；迂回 v. 绕道而行
definition_en: a longer route taken to avoid a problem or to see something on the way, or to follow such a route
core_image: 前方路面塌了一块，橙色箭头把车引向旁边的小路；导航地图上多出一段弯
scene: 我们绕道避开了堵车。We made a detour to avoid the jam.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：detour 指绕道；句意是我们绕道避开了堵车。

senses.title: A longer way round
senses.definition: a longer route taken to avoid a problem on the direct one
senses.definitionCN: 为避开直路上的问题而走的更长路线
senses.example: We made a detour to avoid the jam.
senses.exampleCN: 我们绕道避开了堵车。
senses.why: An orange arrow pointing to a side road.
senses.whyCN: 一个指向旁边小路的橙色箭头。

senses.title: A side trip
senses.definition: a short extra journey made for interest rather than need
senses.definitionCN: 出于兴趣而非需要多走的一小段路
senses.example: They took a detour to see the old mill.
senses.exampleCN: 他们顺道去看了那座老磨坊。
senses.why: A car parked beside a waterwheel.
senses.whyCN: 一辆停在水车旁的汽车。

senses.title: To go round
senses.definition: to follow a longer route instead of the direct one
senses.definitionCN: 走更长的路线而不走直路
senses.example: The bus detoured through the village.
senses.exampleCN: 公交车绕道穿过村子。
senses.why: A bus leaving the main road at a sign.
senses.whyCN: 一辆在路牌处驶离主路的公交车。

intro.en: Detour comes from French detour, from detourner, to turn away, de- aside plus tourner to turn, from Latin tornare, to turn on a lathe.
intro.cn: detour 源自法语 détour，来自 détourner（转开），由 dé-（偏离）加 tourner（转）构成，tourner 来自拉丁语 tornare（用车床旋削）。

items.en: Tornos meant a lathe or turning tool.
items.cn: 希腊语 tornos 意为车床或旋削工具。

items.en: Tornare meant to turn on a lathe.
items.cn: tornare 意为用车床旋削。

items.en: Torner meant to turn.
items.cn: 古法语 torner 意为转动。

items.en: Detourner meant to turn aside.
items.cn: 法语 détourner 意为转到一边。

items.en: Detour entered English for a roundabout way.
items.cn: 十八世纪 detour 以迂回路义进入英语。

items.en: It is also a verb on road signs.
items.cn: 如今它也作动词出现在路牌上。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the torn- turn family; the near-meaning group names other indirect routes.
note.cn: 形近组共享 torn-（转）家族；近义组是其他表示「间接路线」的词。

entries.definition: A journey visiting several places; it shares tornare but is for pleasure, not avoidance.
entries.definitionCN: 游览多地的行程；共享 tornare，但为游玩而非避让。

entries.definition: To move round a point; it is the English descendant of the same turning root.
entries.definitionCN: 绕一点转动；是同一「转」词根的英语后代。

entries.definition: A series of contests; it shares the turning root through the idea of knights wheeling.
entries.definitionCN: 一系列比赛；通过骑士回旋比武的意象共享「转」词根。

entries.definition: A route used when the usual road is closed.
entries.definitionCN: 常用道路封闭时使用的路线。

entries.definition: A road built to go round a town instead of through it.
entries.definitionCN: 为绕过城镇而非穿过它而修的道路。

entries.definition: Not direct; also a circular road junction.
entries.definitionCN: 不直接的；也指环形交叉路口。

normalIntro.en: Detour is de- aside plus tour- turn: turn aside from the straight road and come back later.
normalIntro.cn: detour 就是 de-（偏离）加 tour-（转）：从直路转开，稍后再回来。

normal.en: Tour- means turn, as in tour.
normal.cn: tour- 意为转，如 tour。

normal.en: Make a detour is the common phrase.
normal.cn: make a detour 是常见搭配。

normal.en: Detour can be a verb too.
normal.cn: detour 也可以作动词。

normal.en: A diversion is the British road sign word.
normal.cn: diversion 是英国路牌上的用词。

normal.en: Detour implies coming back to the route.
normal.cn: detour 意味着最终回到原路线。

abstract.en: An orange arrow pointing to a side road.
abstract.cn: 一个指向旁边小路的橙色箭头。

abstract.en: A car parked beside a waterwheel.
abstract.cn: 一辆停在水车旁的汽车。

abstract.en: A bus leaving the main road at a sign.
abstract.cn: 一辆在路牌处驶离主路的公交车。

examples.en: The detour added twenty minutes.
examples.cn: 绕道多花了二十分钟。

examples.en: We detoured around the flooded bridge.
examples.cn: 我们绕过被淹的桥。

examples.en: Several detours were marked in orange.
examples.cn: 几处绕道用橙色标出。

dict_mnemonic.text: detour ＝ dé（偏离）＋ tour（转，与 tour、turn 同根拉丁语 tornare「车床旋削」）＝从直路转开再回来，「绕道」。

root: 希腊语 tornos（车床）→ 拉丁语 tornare（旋削）→ 古法语 torner（转）→ dé-＋tourner → détourner → détour → 英语 detour

sensesIntro.en: One road left and rejoined: an arrow, a waterwheel and a bus at a sign.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一条离开又接回的路：一个箭头、一座水车与路牌处的一辆公交。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an orange arrow pointing to a side road while the main road is dug up ahead
core.cn: 核心意象：前方主路被挖开，一个橙色箭头指向旁边的小路

branches.en: An orange arrow pointing to a side road.
branches.cn: 一个指向旁边小路的橙色箭头。

branches.en: A car parked beside a waterwheel.
branches.cn: 一辆停在水车旁的汽车。

branches.en: A bus leaving the main road at a sign.
branches.cn: 一辆在路牌处驶离主路的公交车。

branches.en: Both leave the direct road on purpose.
branches.cn: 两者都有意离开直路。

branches.en: Both add distance to the journey.
branches.cn: 两者都给行程增加距离。

intro.en: Detour is de- plus tour-; the turn root also builds tour, turn and tournament.
intro.cn: detour 由 de- 加 tour- 构成；转这个词根也造出 tour、turn 与 tournament。

latinIntro.en: Latin tornare means to turn on a lathe, tornus a lathe and via a way.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为用车床旋削，tornus 意为车床，via 意为道路。
